name: epic-stocks
description: Browse your Epic Stocks portfolio in ChatGPT and work with your account through scoped tools.

interface.shortDescription: Your stocks, loans and vesting schedule
interface.longDescription: See your current equity in an inline card, browse grants and loans, and inspect upcoming vesting events. Connect your own Epic Stocks account with OAuth. Editing remains subject to the permissions you grant. This is an independent app, not an official Epic product.
